table.name: TERRAIN_ACTOR_SURFACE_FLAGS_TABLE
table.use: bit 7 selects actor offset +0x09 horizontal orientation marker

boundary_basis: Actor_TerrainCollisionLoop loads the table base at 0x0000683E.
The consumer indexes with an unsigned byte, giving a complete 256-entry lookup extent.
The resulting range ends at 0x0000693D immediately before the separate camera-scroll data beginning at 0x0000693E.
